## 1.0.0 (2026-08-06)

First tagged release. The worker had been deployed from `main` before this; the tag is what makes a
deployed revision one anyone can check out.

### Features

- Per-caller [ntfy](https://ntfy.sh) notifications through the `ntfy=` parameter, sent only when a DNS
  record actually changes
- Multi-hostname updates in one request, across zones, with every record's own outcome reported when a
  batch applies part-way
- Multi-zone tokens with optional `zone=` scoping
- Dual-stack `ip4`/`ip6` with family-aware `auto`
- Optional `ACCESS_KEY` lockdown, checked timing-safe before any Cloudflare API call
- D1 audit trail queryable at `GET /history`, keyset-paginated and scoped to the calling token
- A refusal counter that tallies the hostnames a token reaches for past its own authority

### Build System

- Deploys run from release tags rather than every push to `main`, so the D1 schema in production
  corresponds to a revision that can be checked out
